subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Letter-sound relationships of most single letters; consonant and vowel substitution word play

show.line: Four sounds! r, r, rat. l, l, leg. b, b, bus. f, f, fan.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with r, as in rat?
Which one starts with l, as in leg?
Say the sound with me. f, as in fan!
Tap the letter that says b.
rounds.praise: Yes! b has a tall back and a round tummy.

rounds.prompt: Bat. Change b to r. What word do you make?
Trace f with your finger. Curl at the top, go down, then across.
Does it start with r, l, b or f? Sort the pictures.

hints: Listen for the first sound. r growls. l sings.
f blows air through your teeth. b pops.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with l.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Rat starts with r. Leg starts with l.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. l, l, leg. Leg starts with l!

parent_line: Can hear and recognise the sounds r, l, b and f.
